description.zh: 输入主题大纲，AI自动排版并生成专业警务汇报演示文稿。
description.en: Enter a topic outline and AI auto-formats a professional police briefing deck.

welcome_message.zh: 给我汇报主题与大纲，我用内置 pptx 技能生成演示文稿
welcome_message.en: Give me the topic and outline — I'll generate the deck with the built-in pptx skill

description.zh: 输入：汇报主题、大纲与受众。预期产物：outbound/<task>/ 下的 briefing.pptx（内置 pptx 技能生成）与 outline.md（逐页内容）
description.en: Input: topic, outline and audience. Output: briefing.pptx (via built-in pptx skill) and outline.md under outbound/<task>/

prompt.zh:
请生成专业警务汇报演示文稿。

汇报主题：

大纲（各章节要点）：

受众与时长：

预期产物：调用内置 pptx 技能，在 outbound/<task>/ 下生成 briefing.pptx，并输出 outline.md（逐页标题与要点）。版式规范统一、重点突出，示例数据明确标注为演示数据。
prompt.en:
Please generate a professional police briefing deck.

Topic:

Outline (section key points):

Audience and duration:

Expected output: use the built-in pptx skill to produce briefing.pptx under outbound/<task>/ plus outline.md (per-slide titles and bullets). Consistent layout with clear highlights; label sample data as demo data.
